verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to Jeremiah for the second time. He was still confined in the prison of the governor.
verses.2: As Jehovah has said, so does Jehovah create it. Jehovah prepares it for its purpose. It is Jehovah’s name.
verses.3: Call me, and I will answer you. I will tell you about the great things and the difficult things that you do not know.
verses.4: For thus said Yahweh, the God of Israel, regarding the daughters of this city and the daughters of the kings of Judah who go into captivity and into exile.
verses.5: We come to fight against those evil people and to destroy their corpses. They are those whom I have killed with my hands and with my fire. I also hid my face from this city, due to all their evil deeds.
verses.6: I am here to heal them, to bring them peace and truth.
verses.7: And I will restore the unity of Judah and Israel, as it was in ancient times.
verses.8: And I have forgiven them all their sins. I have forgotten all their transgressions against me. They sinned against me, but I have forgiven them all.
verses.9: And it will be a source of pride and honor for me, and for all the nations of the earth. They will hear all the good things that I do for them. Then they will be afraid and rejoice over all the good things and peace that I bring to them.
verses.10: So said Jehovah: “Once again, I will hear from this place where you say, ‘It has been destroyed by people and animals.’ In the cities of Judah and in the suburbs of Jerusalem, there will be no more living beings, no one who can live anymore.”
verses.11: The sound of joy and gladness, the sound of bridegroom and bride. The sound of those who praise Jehovah, the armies of God. For Jehovah is good forever; His kindness comes upon us. Praise the house of Jehovah! For He has once again taken back the land from its enemies. As Jehovah said:
verses.12: As Jehovah, the Almighty, said: “There will be no one left in this place; not even animals or people. In every city, there will be only evil people who are causing chaos.”
verses.13: In the cities of the hills, in the cities of the lowlands, and in the cities of the Negev. Also in the land of Benjamin, and around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the oxen will still be driven along by the command of God. As Jehovah said.
verses.14: Now, days are coming, says the LORD. I will carry out what is good that I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.15: In those days and at that time, I will bring forth a tree of righteousness for David. I will make justice and righteousness prevail in this land.
verses.16: In those days, Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will be established in peace. And this is what Jehovah, our God, says: “May it be so!”
verses.17: For thus said the LORD: “No one shall sit on the throne of Israel’s house.”
verses.18: And the priests, who are holy, shall not be dishonored by anyone. They shall not offer sacrifices or make offerings on any day.
verses.19: And the word of Jehovah was given to Jeremias, saying:
verses.20: Thus said Jehovah: If you break my covenant today and tomorrow, then there will be no day or night for you at all.
verses.21: Also, I will make David my servant become king over him. And I will make the priests his ministers.
verses.22: Whoever does not record the armies of heaven, and whoever does not remember the diseases of the sea… I will scatter the seeds of David’s servants, and I will scatter those who serve me.
verses.23: And the word of Jehovah was sent to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.24: Have you ever seen this people speak in such a way? They said, “These are the two tribes that Jehovah chose. He saved them from being destroyed by their enemies.”
verses.25: So said Yahweh: “If I do not make a covenant with you, day and night, with the laws of heaven and earth, then I will not place them upon you.”
verses.26: Also, the seeds of Jacob and David are my servants. May they be taken from their own seeds and given to the seeds of Abraham. May they be restored to their rightful place, and may they receive forgiveness.
